title: Braun Still Life — Function in Silence
description: A single-product hero slide modeled on Braun's 1970s industrial catalog pages: one calm silhouette, a name, a function sentence. Where other minimalist templates still reach for geometric ornament, this one refuses even that.
philosophy: This template trusts the object completely. It holds that a well-made product, given room to breathe against a warm field, needs no decoration to argue for itself. It rejects gradients, icon libraries, drop shadows, and any shape that does not carry information. The speaker who chooses it must believe in the thing they are showing — the layout offers nowhere to hide, and considers that a feature.
goodFor: Consumer electronics or hardware product launch announcements
Industrial design firm credentials and portfolio decks
3-line product-naming reveals requiring maximum visual stillness
Design-award submission boards with one hero artifact per slide
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly business reviews requiring data density
Multi-product feature comparison or pricing-table slides
High-energy sales-kickoff presentations needing motion and color
Slides with more than two concurrent callouts or annotation layers
author: harness

examples.promptCore: Braun-era catalog stillness — one product object floats against a warm, unbroken ground with no supporting shapes, shadows, or ornamentation of any kind. The composition is quietly asymmetric: the mass of the object gravitates slightly left of center while sparse text anchors the lower register with unhurried confidence. The overall mood is serious and material-honest, the kind of designed silence that persuades without raising its voice. Avoid any hint of marketing vitality, decorative geometry, or layered atmospheric depth.

examples.layoutNotes: Twelve-column grid with a generous outer margin creating breathing room on all sides. Product silhouette occupies the upper two-thirds of the slide, placed in columns 3–10 and vertically floated within that zone so the warm field surrounds it completely. A single hairline rule spans columns 2–11, cleanly dividing the image territory from the text register below it. Title and a one-sentence function descriptor sit left-weighted in columns 2–7 of the lower register, with a small deck identifier anchored bottom-right, outside the text block.

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a page torn from a 1970s Braun product catalog left open on a clean desk — unhurried, quietly authoritative, certain of itself. Composition is asymmetric: sparse factual language occupies the left third while the right half is surrendered almost entirely to the object and its shadow of negative space. The mood is functional restraint without austerity — warm, not cold; considered, not sparse for its own sake. Avoid any decorative geometry, icon embellishment, or visual layering that competes with the silhouette; the object is the argument.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a generous 9% outer margin on all sides. Text content occupies cols 2–5: a thin horizontal rule sits above a short category label, followed by 2–3 lines of body copy set at a deliberate size step below the label. The product silhouette bleeds softly into cols 7–12, vertically centered against the warm field with no bounding box or shadow. A discreet folio anchors bottom-right at the outer margin edge; nothing else occupies the footer. Hierarchy is carried entirely by rule line and scale contrast — no weight-bold headers, no background panels.
